service.description: The send outcomes of the instance's stored outgoing mail (EmailMessage: Ready, Sent, Bounced or Cancelled; never a draft, a scheduled message or received mail), newest first, a page at a time (outcomeList, outcomeCount). Each: the message's id, status, state (retryable: not sent; permanent: refused; bounced; uncertain: it may have been sent; settled: a person reported what became of an uncertain send, with settlement delivered or notDelivered, its text, settledByUserId, settledByName, settledDate and settledReason; sending; sent: only what a send of it succeeded in, never a settlement; cancelled) with its text, the outcome the mail service kept, the time, the number of recipients, the error with every address struck out, its mail server, template and binding (account: a mail account's message; instance: the instance's own), its owner (ownerKind mailAccount, registered with the owner's key, title, reference and state, or mailService), what may be done here (retryEligible, reconcileEligible, abandonEligible, each only with ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE), the next step in words and the revision an action names. Never a subject, body, header, address or attachment: no parameter returns one. Narrowed by state (attention, the default: Ready and Bounced that nobody settled; retryable, permanent, uncertain, bounced, settled, sent, all), mail server, template, binding, one message and dates (by default the last defaultDays days). An owner that could not be asked is named in unansweredOwnerList, and nothing of the instance's own is then offered a retry. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW; with ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW alone, only the instance's own mail is read (instanceOnly), never a mail account's message.

Send again a message that is known not sent (retryable, permanent or bounced) or that a person settled as not delivered, through its owner, at the revision read. A message of the mail service's own (no mail account, no registered owner) is claimed first and then sent by org.moqui.mail.EmailServices.send#EmailMessage: the same stored message, never a new one. A registered owner's message is retried by that owner's own service when it offers one (OWNER_RETRIES when it does not). The claim clears a settlement, and the send's own result is then the message's state. Refused, with the reason: a message that may have been sent and that nobody settled (RECONCILE_REQUIRED), one settled as delivered (SETTLED), one in a mail account's Outbox (OWNER_ONLY: its sender's), one already sent or cancelled (NOT_FAILED), one being sent (IN_PROGRESS), a stale revision (STALE_REVISION), an owner that could not be asked (OWNER_UNAVAILABLE) and a send that fails again (SEND_FAILED, with the new state). With an operationKey a repeat answers the first result (repeated) and sends nothing. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE.

What a person concluded about a message whose send is uncertain, with the reason (required), at the revision read: delivered (the mail server's own log shows it went) or notDelivered. Either is recorded as the message's settlement (EmailMessage sendSettlement with who, when and the reason, and an audit log row), apart from its sent state: the status and sendOutcome stay what the transport left, the message is never marked Sent, and it is then listed as settled, out of what needs attention. One settled as notDelivered may be sent again (retry#MailOutcome). A settled message is not settled again (ALREADY_SETTLED). abandon closes a failed or uncertain message of the mail service's own (Cancelled: not offered again). Nothing is sent. A registered owner's message is reconciled by that owner's own service first, which checks the owner's permission (OWNER_RECONCILES when it offers none), and the settlement is then recorded here the same way; a mail account's message is its sender's (OWNER_ONLY). Refused too for a message that is not uncertain (NOT_UNCERTAIN, for delivered and notDelivered), one sent or cancelled (NOT_FAILED), a stale revision and an owner that could not be asked. With an operationKey a repeat answers the first result. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE.

Internal to retry#MailOutcome (in no group's grant; it checks ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE itself): in a transaction of its own, the message locked and, while it is still at the revision read and still known not sent, marked uncertain with the claim's time, so a second request and a server that stops part way both find it held; a settlement as not delivered is cleared with it. With release the claim's time is cleared.

What a registered owner of mail send outcomes answers (moqui.server.MailOutcomeOwner ownerService): which of the given EmailMessages are its own (ownerList: emailMessageId, ownerRef the owner's own record, ownerStateText its state there in words, retryEligible and reconcileEligible when its recover service would take that action now, selfRetrying when it tries the message again on its own). A message it does not answer is not its own. It reads its own records only and returns no address, subject or body.

A registered owner's own action on one of its messages (MailOutcomeOwner recoverService): retry (send it again its own way), or the reconciliation of an uncertain send, sent or notSent. The owner checks its own permission and its record's state, and answers applied, or reasonCode and reason; the registration adds no right.

The instance's system messages (moqui.service.message.SystemMessage), newest first, a page at a time (messageList, messageCount). Each: its id, type, remote (and whether that remote is disabled), direction, status and state (waiting; retrying: failed and tried again on its own; failed; inProgress; uncertain: a send or a consume that never answered, so it may have been sent or applied; settled: an uncertain one a person settled, which stays in its status and is never listed as done, with settlement (done or notDone), settlementText, settledByName, settledDate and settledReason; done; staged; rejected; cancelled) with its text, its times and failed attempts, the class of its last error and, unless its owner answers per message and does not let this reader (a store's or an organization's scope is the owner's), its remote, its correlation ids (messageId, remoteMessageId), who settled it and why, and one line of the error with what a remote answered, addresses, URL paths and tokens struck out; what is registered for it (the owner, its own state there, the key of its own place) and what may be done here (retryEligible, requeueEligible, reconcileEligible, cancelEligible, each only with ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE and a registered recovery) with the next step in words, and the revision an action names. Never a message's text. Narrowed by state (attention, the default: failed and uncertain; failed, uncertain, settled, waiting, done, closed, all), type, remote, direction (in, out), a reference (a whole message id, envelope id or remote id) and dates (by default the last defaultDays days). Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW.

One system message's evidence: its row as find#Messages answers it (message, with its content type, the length of its text and the number of messages split from it), its failed attempts (attemptList: time, what was attempted, the error's class and, where its owner lets this reader, its masked line), its status history from the audit log (historyList: time, from, to and, where its owner lets this reader, who and the reason), and each recovery action with whether it may be taken now, why not, and what it would do (actionList, as preview#Recovery). Its payload (payloadText, cut to 20,000 characters, values of fields named like a credential struck out) is answered only when asked for (includePayload) and only when the type's owner registered the permission that reads it, the reader holds it and, where the owner answers per message, the owner says this reader may see it; otherwise payloadHiddenReason says why not. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW.

Internal to execute#Recovery (in no group's grant; it checks ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE itself): one step on a system message in a transaction of its own, the row locked, still at the revision read and still in the state the step is for. claim marks the attempt, so a second request at that revision finds the message changed (one reported not done is moved to Error with its settlement cleared, for the send or consume that follows); requeue (reset#SystemMessageInError) and cancel (cancel#SystemMessage) take a message in Error only; done and notDone record the settlement of one whose outcome is unknown (outcomeSettlement with who, when and the reason): its status is left as the transport left it, never set Sent or Consumed by a person's word.

parameter.name: step
parameter.description: claim, requeue, cancel, done or notDone

service.description: What may be done now to each of up to 25 operational records of one kind (targetKind: SystemMessage), and what it would do; nothing is changed. previewList, in the order asked: targetId, found, title, state and its text, the revision an action names, what is registered for it (descriptorKey, ownerApp, ownerTitle, ownerRoute, ownerPermission, idempotencyNote, the owner's own reference and state) and actionList: for each action of the kind (a message: retry, requeue, reconcile, cancel) its label, eligible, the reason when not (reasonCode NOT_REGISTERED: no owner registered a recovery for it; NOT_OFFERED; OWNER_PERMISSION; RECONCILE_REQUIRED: its outcome is unknown, so it is settled, never retried; NOT_UNCERTAIN; ALREADY_SETTLED; SETTLED: reported done by the person who settled it, so never sent or consumed again; NOT_FAILED; IN_PROGRESS; REMOTE_DISABLED; OWNER_UNAVAILABLE; NOT_OWNED; OWNER_REFUSES; PERMISSION), the consequence in words and a reconciliation's resolutions. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW; an action is eligible only with ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE.

parameter.name: targetId
parameter.description: One id, or several comma separated, when no list is given

service.description: The registered action (retry, requeue, reconcile with a resolution done or notDone, cancel) on each of up to 25 records of one kind, with the reason (required, kept in the audit log), each named with the revision it was read at (targetList of targetId and expectedRevision, or one targetId and expectedRevision). Each record is on its own: read again, refused when it changed (STALE_REVISION) or is not eligible now (the reasons of preview#Recovery), claimed in a transaction of its own, then acted on by what its owner registered: the framework's own action for that same record (a message is sent or consumed again as itself, never as a new one), or the owner's own service, which checks the owner's permission and scope. A record whose outcome is unknown is never retried: it is reconciled, and nothing is sent by that, nor is the record marked sent or consumed: the settlement is kept beside it (reported done, or reported not done, which may then be retried). One that is refused or fails (RETRY_FAILED, OWNER_REFUSED, FAILED) is named in its result and the others go on: resultList has a row per record (targetId, applied, reasonCode, reason, its state and revision afterwards), with appliedCount and refusedCount; applied says whether any was. With an operationKey a repeat of the same batch by the same user answers the first results (repeated) and does nothing again. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE, and the owner's permission where its registration names one.

What the owner of a registered recovery answers about its records (moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor describeService): for those of the given ids that are its own (targetList: targetId, ownerRef the owner's own record, ownerStateText its state there in words), what its recover service would take now for this caller (retryEligible, reconcileEligible, cancelEligible, and reason when none), whether the outcome is unknown at the owner (uncertain: it is then reconciled, never retried), and whether this caller may see the record's diagnostics (detailVisible) and payload (payloadVisible) by the owner's own permission and scope. A record it does not answer is not its own. It changes nothing and returns no payload.

A registered owner's own action on one of its records (RecoveryDescriptor recoverService): retry, reconcile (resolution done or notDone) or cancel, with the reason and an operation key whose repeat the owner answers with its first result. The owner checks its own permission, scope and the record's state, keeps the record's identity, and answers applied, or reasonCode and reason; the registration adds no right.
